title: Reforge: Low-Latency Distributed GNN Serving with Selective Embedding Recomputation
abstract: arXiv:2501.08547v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have been widely adopted for their ability to compute expressive node representations in graph datasets. However, serving GNNs on large graphs is challenging due to the high communication, computation, and memory overheads of constructing and executing computation graphs, which represent information flow across large neighborhoods. Existing approximation techniques in training can mitigate the overheads but, in serving, still lead to high latency and/or accuracy loss. To this end, we propose Reforge, a system that enables low-latency GNN serving for large graphs with minimal accuracy loss through two key ideas. First, Reforge employs selective recomputation of precomputed embeddings, which allows for reusing precomputed computation subgraphs while selectively recomputing a small fraction to minimize accuracy loss. Second, we develop computation graph parallelism, which reduces communication overhead

translated_title: Reforge：基于选择性嵌入重计算的低延迟分布式GNN服务系统
translated_abstract: 图神经网络因其能够在图数据集中计算富有表现力的节点表示而被广泛采用。然而，在大型图上部署GNN服务极具挑战性，因为构建和执行计算图（用于表示跨大邻域的信息流）会带来高昂的通信、计算和内存开销。现有的训练近似技术虽然可以缓解这些开销，但在服务场景中仍会导致高延迟和/或精度损失。为此，我们提出了Reforge系统，通过两个关键思想实现大型图上低延迟且精度损失最小的GNN服务。首先，Reforge采用预计算嵌入的选择性重计算方法，允许重用预计算的计算子图，同时选择性地重计算其中一小部分以最小化精度损失。其次，我们开发了计算图并行机制，降低了通信开销。
tldr: Reforge通过选择性重计算预计算嵌入和计算图并行两项关键技术，实现了大规模图上低延迟、高精度的分布式GNN服务。
en_tdlr: Reforge enables low-latency, high-accuracy distributed GNN serving on large graphs through selective embedding recomputation and computation graph parallelism.
